BiblicalUsage: Dannah is named once, as a town in the hill country of Judah given to the tribe in the allotment. It is one name in the long list of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list matters because the inheritance was real: every town was counted, and every family had its place.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
